title: Check if an Array Is Consecutive
summary: Determine if an integer array is consecutive by checking if it includes every number from the smallest element to the smallest element plus the array's length minus one.
statement: Determine if an integer array is consecutive by checking if it includes every number from the smallest element to the smallest element plus the array's length minus one.
constraints: The array is consecutive when it contains every integer from its minimum through its maximum exactly once.
The original order does not matter and values may be negative.
Return false for duplicates or any missing value.
reference_solution:
def is_consecutive_array(nums):
    return len(set(nums))==len(nums) and max(nums)-min(nums)+1==len(nums)
hints: A consecutive set has no duplicates and its inclusive numeric span equals its size.
Use a set for uniqueness, then compare max-min+1 with the array length.
Distinct integers filling an interval of exactly n positions must occupy every position; either failed condition proves a duplicate or gap.
editorial: Distinct integers filling an interval of exactly n positions must occupy every position; either failed condition proves a duplicate or gap.

tests.explanation: The set is exactly {1,2,3,4}, so all four consecutive values are present.
The value two is missing between the minimum and maximum.
